rows.label: tlk70000137_10_msg0002
rows.name:
His Majesty has tremendous support
even among the people of other
countries...

rows.label: tlk70000137_10_msg0003
rows.name:
I doubt any emperor has ever been
loved this much by the people of other
countries.

rows.label: tlk70000137_10_msg0005
rows.name:
As Special Commissioner, I
want to fight Heaven's Holy Grail
by His Majesty's side...

rows.label: tlk70000137_10_msg0006
rows.name:
But for the Empire's future, I'll
swallow my feelings and put my duty
first...

rows.label: tlk70000137_10_msg0007
rows.name: Your Majesty... Good luck in battle.
